explanation: Pointing directly at someone with your index finger is considered rude in Turkey — multiple Turkish-focused etiquette sources state plainly that 'it is rude to point at someone here,' often associating the gesture with accusation. Turks typically indicate people or directions with an open hand or a nod instead.
local_tip: Gesture with an open hand (palm up or down) instead of your index finger when indicating a person or direction.

also_check.note: Pointing with the index finger is very rude; use an open hand or a gentle wave instead.
Pointing with the index finger is common and generally acceptable in casual contexts.
Pointing with the index finger is impolite; use the thumb or a closed fist with thumb extended instead.

sources.title: Not bad intentions, it's just etiquette in Turkey
